notes.title: Paraplasm : Beyond the Veil will be released on October 28th!
notes.notes:
[b]Paraplasm : Beyond the Veil will be released on October 28th! [/b]

After 1 year of development, "Paraplasm : Beyond the Veil" is finally here! I developed this game on my own and faced a lot of difficulties while developing it. I am very happy and proud that I was able to successfully overcome them all. "Paraplasm : Beyond the Veil" is my 2nd game and I tried my best. Thank you to everyone who supported me.

notes.title: Fixed Main Menu White Screen Issue. (All versions)
notes.notes: I fixed the white screen problem in the main menu for both the demo version and the full version.

notes.title: Paraplasm: Beyond the Veil Demo is OUT!
notes.notes: You can download and try the Paraplasm: Beyond the Veil demo from our store page! Don't forget to enter our Discord channel and leave feedback! Thanks!
